  PROBLEM: The opt-out check performs a naive substring search over pr["title"] + " " + pr["body"] rather than implementing the canonical [skip ai] marker contract.
  WHY: A PR that mentions [skip ai] in markdown, fenced code, or discussion is falsely classified as opted out.

  PROBLEM: The PR snapshot is recorded before the review-dispatch loop and is used without checking whether the PR head advanced.
  WHY: If a developer pushes during the sweep, rerun_failed_jobs() is invoked on the old head_sha and reruns a superseded commit.

  PROBLEM: list_runs() rejects the whole listing if any pull-request association has a missing or malformed head SHA.
